1. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fasihi Simulizi 1.1.1 Misingi ya Fasihi Simulizi Fasihi Simulizi katika Jamii ya.

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Ushairi 1.2.1 Uainishaji wa Mashairi ya Arudhi ● Mishororo ● Vipande.

3. B — fupi

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza Ujumbe na fani katika matin.

5. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Utangulizi wa Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia.

12. B — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
